title: torilis leptocarpa
intro: Torilis leptocarpa, commonly known as Hemlock Parsley or Wild Chervil, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antispasmodic. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and essential oils, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, Torilis leptocarpa has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and mucolytic properties.
